global_statistics: Coordinate-wise channel-weighted mean and population SD on this fold's FIT patients only. Physical moments fitted within each sub-FIT for OOF calibration. Latent moments use the current encoder in eval/no-grad at initialization and after each epoch; preserve all RNG/training modes/BN buffers. Each selected checkpoint binds its final FIT moments. No extra optimizer steps.
feature_pipeline: Normalization replaces the original patient-relative view before the same legal FIT imputer/scaler. Global uses the canonical original no-PR TRAIN scaler once. Center=(x-patient_mean)/TRAIN_sd; Scale=(x-TRAIN_mean)/patient_sd. Full/noPR reuse requires original preprocessing and validation equality. The final model changes both branches together, retains its two inactive storage slots at zero, and retains pre-onset subtraction.
numerical_support: Population SD, float64 moment calculation, original per-family support/zero rules; no result-dependent floor. Physiological parent rule uses SD>1e-8*FIT_unit_scale else zero; raw rule uses SD if>1e-8 else denominator1. Global StandardScaler zero variance fallback1. All constants remain.

svm.calibration: Original 3 patient-group folds inside FIT, refit all global/view/imputer/scaler parameters within each sub-FIT. Original patient/class weights. SVC linear, probabilityFalse, unchanged native solver budget. Original OOF Platt logistic regression. No search.

neural.raw_precision: original BF16 train FP32 eval, exact-gradient-cache chunk128 TF32off
neural.loss: Own original 0.75 weighted BCE +0.25 soft macro; TimeConv original weighted BCE. Complete-patient updates, original initializations and epoch patient order. Same architecture/head/parameter count.

output_processing.input: EZ native logit: negative neural NEZ logit; SVM frozen Platt decision_function applied to frozen SVC margin. Never probability-to-logit clipping.
output_processing.fitting: No new weights/calibration/checkpoint selection. Select only validation threshold with the corresponding parent's original 201-point grid and tie/orientation policy. Expose orientation explicitly.
output_processing.ranking: Use exact frozen noPR ranking anchor; separately validate affine-order preservation, so sigmoid quantization cannot manufacture ranking gains.

selection: Same parent validation threshold/checkpoint rules per family. All105 choices freeze before any new test evaluation; all105 score cells seal before metrics. Reuse old selected checkpoint and original numeric threshold for NoPR/Full. No patient, run, arm or unfavorable-result exclusion.

statistics.sampling: Paired unique patients independently within original source counts36/21/15/8; equal patients overall. Not channels or runs as independent units.
statistics.primary: FullPR minus ScoreZ, MacroF1 and AUROC for three models:6 nominal95 and6 Bonferroni percentile intervals at tails0.05/12.
statistics.secondary: All Full-minus and postprocess-minus-NoPR contrasts with nominal95 descriptive intervals. Complete source, source-equal, worst-source, fold and coverage tables. SVM Global/NoPR explicitly aliases, not independent replication.
statistics.interpretation: No presumed PR win. Output affine alignment cannot improve ranking. A cross-zero interval is inconclusive, not equivalence. Historical cohort and outcome-informed development remain exploratory.

release: Only anonymous aggregate CSV/JSON, protocol/source hashes, reuse/coverage/verification metadata and Chinese findings. No identities, patient/channel metrics or predictions, raw signals, features, embeddings, references/scalers, model/optimizer states, runtime logs, credentials. Existing JBHI tables/figures remain unchanged.
